meta.name: proof-of-work
meta.description: Run the machine-verifiable gate (typecheck/test/lint, plus a screenshot for UI) so an agent's diff is "review-ready" before it reaches a human. Triggers "proof of work", "is this review-ready", "verify before review", "prove it is green", or after an agent finishes a diff-producing task.

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 在代码审查前自动运行类型检查、测试和lint，确保diff通过验证。
copy.fit_line: 适合你，如果你想让agent的代码在提交审查前自动通过质量门控。
copy.tagline_en: Automatically run typecheck, test, and lint on diffs before code review.
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you want agent-generated code to pass automated quality gates before human review.

howto.what: 装上后，Claude 在完成代码改动后会自动运行类型检查、测试和代码检查，并生成一份“可审查”或“不可审查”的报告，UI 改动还会附带截图。
howto.when: 当你说出“proof of work”、“is this review-ready”等触发词，或 Claude 完成一个产生代码改动的任务后自动触发。

say.text: 检查这个 PR 是否审查就绪。
say.note: Claude 会运行自动化检查并报告结果。

say.text: 运行 proof-of-work 验证我的改动。
say.note: Claude 会执行类型检查、测试和 lint。

say.text: 请证明这个 diff 是绿色的。
say.note: Claude 会运行检查并返回“可审查”或“不可审查”。

howto.what_en: After installation, Claude automatically runs type checking, tests, and linting on code changes, producing a "review-ready" or "not review-ready" report, plus a screenshot for UI changes.
howto.when_en: Triggered when you say "proof of work", "is this review-ready", etc., or automatically after Claude completes a diff-producing task.

say_en.text: Check if this PR is review-ready.
say_en.note: Claude runs the automated checks and reports the result.
Claude executes typecheck, test, and lint.
Claude runs checks and returns "review-ready" or "not review-ready".
